pages.note: Actual phone Auth SDK, native operator, owner HTTP RPC and PostgreSQL permissions. The M14 order detail gains an independently versioned estimate; current order, preparation and money are untouched. The first historical promise is seeded explicitly, and the newer range is recorded through the real owner controls. Floating navigation/actions are laid out statically for the full capture, preserving all controls.
